test_cases.name: List All VPCEP Endpoints
test_cases.expected: HTTP 200 with endpoint list (names, IDs, status, VPC, IP, creation)

test_cases.name: List VPCEP Endpoints Filtered By Name
test_cases.expected: HTTP 200 with endpoints whose name contains {endpoint_name}

test_cases.name: Show VPCEP Summary With Total Count
test_cases.command: hcloud VPCEP ListEndpoints --cli-region=cn-north-4 --limit=100 | jq '{total_count, endpoints: [.endpoints[] | {name, id, status, vpc_id, endpoint_ip, created_at}]}'
test_cases.expected: HTTP 200 with total_count and core fields
